summary: Numerical retrieval scores independently reproduced. Delivery defects corrected; mixed historical README is warned rather than fully isolated, and initial index/publication identities were not prefrozen.

gt_provenance.details: 100 questions, 41 evidence groups, 60 source quotations independently checked. Automatic source-anchored labels, without external human acceptance. Historical README receives explicit scope warning; chunk-level scope isolation remains incomplete.

score_normalization.details: All 780 records independently recomputed, zero discrepancies. Recall uses evidence-group denominators; negatives excluded from Recall/MRR.

result_existence.details: All 89 original frozen files and local model/index assets verified. Clean reconstruction repaired and tested. Original freeze did not anchor index/publication policy; future freezes strengthened without rewriting history.

dead_code.details: Metrics and 10 grouped-bootstrap intervals executed and independently reproduced. error_citations empty placeholder is not interpreted as a measured error rate.

scope.details: Limited 100-question proxy experiment, one split. Holdout thresholds frozen from development. Five timing repetitions are not five independent evaluations. Improvement CI spans zero.

retained_limitations: initial indexes and publisher not frozen before ranking experiment
mixed historical README scoped using warnings rather than complete chunk filtering
strict negative return is an abstention proxy, not an LLM hallucination rate
reviewers from same model family; provisional semantic judgment
remote bytes not all independently redownloaded by reviewer
